title: Really bad
body: I bought the subscription for a year and the widget wasn’t showing anywhere. I restarted the device as it was instructed and nothing happened, so I decided to reinstall the app. Now I cannot restore my subscription and no longer have access to premium features. Really really bad.
author: bomatix

title: Subscription based model doesn’t honor previous purchases
body: If you bought the app before moving to the subscription model, you have to buy it again. Restoring purchases doesn’t work. Bad business practice.
author: LaDiDaDiBlejanjeNaAdi
